title: Regional construction vendors — price reputation and web sentiment

method.chains: Reuse verified unit prices from data/research/*-lowest-prices.json (no new scrape).
method.local_depos: Portuguese web search of directories, review pages, Reclame Aqui snippets, and local guides; qualitative price reputation only unless a cited SKU price exists.
method.scoring: 0–100 composite of price_reputation (40), sentiment (25), assortment_fit_for_35_expenses (20), logistics_to_nova_odessa (15).
method.caveat: Local depo prices are almost never published as comparable SKUs online; treat reputation_only rows as cotação candidates, not verified winners.

333obra.note: Americana storefront used as Nova Odessa proxy in prior sweep; thinnest verified coverage.

vendors.name: Construeva Materiais de Construção

rating_signals.snippet: Multiple customers cite 'ótimos preços', 'preço top', 'material é mais baixo', 'preço incrível'.

strengths: Strongest public price-positive review volume among Americana local depos found in this pass
Full-line (alicerce ao acabamento): cimento, ferro, pisos, hidráulica, elétrica
weaknesses: No machine-verifiable SKU prices online for EXP_* comparison
One review notes prices 'iguais aos concorrentes' with service as differentiator

vendors.name: Sodimac Brasil

rating_signals.snippet: Described as competitive especially on acabamentos and ferramentas; mid price band overall.

strengths: Best verified coverage in project catalogs (31/35)
Most lowest-price wins across shared EXP_* (13)
Strong on tinta 18L (R$99.90) and vaso in verified sweep
weaknesses: Interior door winner much higher than Leroy Merlin in verified set
Still no m³ aggregates in catalog

vendors.name: 333Obra

rating_signals.snippet: Markets 'preço mais barato da região' for cement; sample CSN 50kg from R$34.50 listing / prior Americana Pix sweep R$29.00 winner.

strengths: Lowest verified cement in project catalogs (R$29.00)
Americana proximity for Nova Odessa pickup/delivery proxy
weaknesses: Thinnest verified catalog (16/35)
Many EXP_* still no_match

vendors.name: Depósito Ouro Verde Materiais de Construção
vendors.address: Rua Igaci / Jardim Cristina area — Campinas/SP

rating_signals.snippet: Positions as distributor of areia/pedra with competitive prices, technical/environmental reports, and fleet delivery across RMC including Sumaré.

strengths: Specialist for bulk aggregates — fills chain gap on EXP_0015 (areia/pedrisco m³)
Claims delivery across Campinas metro / Sumaré corridor toward Nova Odessa
weaknesses: Not a full acabamento catalog in public materials
No citable SKU unit prices in this research pass

vendors.name: Leroy Merlin

rating_signals.snippet: Competitive on volume and weekend promos; mid band for complete projects.
High complaint volume nationally; local Campinas Anhanguera mentions appear in complaint list (e.g. measures/delivery).

strengths: Strong verified openings prices (porta interna R$307.30; janelas/vitrôs)
Wide e-commerce + Campinas stores (Anhanguera / Dom Pedro)
weaknesses: Weaker verified coverage than Sodimac/Telhanorte (23/35)
Brand-level Reclame Aqui reputation only Regular

weaknesses: Fewer lowest-price wins (5) vs Sodimac

ranking.rationale: Best local web evidence that customers associate the store with low/fair prices plus full-line assortment and Americana logistics for Nova Odessa.
Strongest verified SKU coverage and most lowest-price wins in project catalogs; use for comparable e-commerce/checkout buys.
Aggressive cement pricing and Americana footprint; weaker breadth — spot-buy structural staples after cotação.
Primary candidate for m³ areia/pedrisco where all chains returned no_match; price claim is reputation-only.
Best verified openings prices; mid overall price band and Regular Reclame Aqui brand score.
Reliable mid-tier catalog with promo strength on basics; fewer absolute lows than Sodimac.
Consistent 'preço acessível' review language; logistics less convenient than Americana.
Close dual-store Americana option marketing best prices; thin independent reviews.
Useful masonry-focused cotação target; insufficient public price sentiment.
Delivery-speed play for basics; not proven cheapest.
In-town convenience only until a quoted price sheet exists.
Local hydraulics-capable depo; no web price proof.
Registry-confirmed local retailer without public sentiment.
Directory-only; include for WhatsApp cotação sweep, not ranked for price.

gaps.local_edge: Depósito Ouro Verde (and similar aggregate distributors) are the practical cotação path.

gaps.chains: 333Obra R$29 verified lowest; Sodimac R$32.90; LM/Telhanorte R$34.90.
gaps.local_edge: Local depos may beat chains on bulk/pro pricing — require WhatsApp quote before preferring chains.

gaps.chains: Leroy Merlin verified strongest on interior door unit price among chains.
gaps.local_edge: Construeva reviews mention variety/acabamentos but no comparable SKU proof; keep LM as verified baseline.

gaps.chains: Sodimac R$99.90 far below LM R$199.90 / Telhanorte R$149.90 in verified set.
gaps.local_edge: Unknown until local quote; do not assume depo wins without quote.
Alvorada, Ceron, Casa do Construtor, Pezão exist but web evidence is registry/directory-thin — treat as pickup/top-up, not proven lowest price.

recommended_buying_split_for_agents.action: WhatsApp/phone cotação packet to Construeva, Feval, Casa dos Tijolos, Depósito Ouro Verde (aggregates), plus in-town Alvorada/Ceron for freight-sensitive top-ups.
Compare returned quotes against Sodimac/333Obra/LM/Telhanorte winners in *-lowest-prices.json for same EXP_* units.
Prefer local depo only when quote ≤ chain normalized_unit_price_brl for comparable spec; else keep chain winner.
